title: VisionEvent
description: An observation emitted by a vision sidecar consuming one stream from MediaMTX. The sidecar is stateless and emits raw signals only; interpretation (HID actions, alerting, rules) lives in downstream subscribers — typically the betterkvm bridge.

stream_id.description: MediaMTX path name (e.g. cam-a). Matches the trashcam@<id>.service instance and the camera id in the ansible inventory.

ts_capture_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp of the source frame's capture (RTP timestamp mapped to wall clock when available, sidecar receipt time otherwise).

ts_detected_ns.description: Nanosecond wall-clock timestamp when the detector emitted this event. ts_detected_ns - ts_capture_ns approximates capture-to-detection latency.

source.description: Detector family. Phase 1: color, diff, ssim. Phase 2: haar. Phase 3: yolo.

roi.description: Region of interest in source-frame pixel coordinates. Full frame is { x:0, y:0, w:width, h:height }.

metric.description: The scalar measurement this event reports. Detectors may emit multiple metrics per frame as separate events.

name.description: Detector-defined metric name. Examples: mean_bgr_b, mean_bgr_g, mean_bgr_r, mean_hsv_h, mean_hsv_s, mean_hsv_v, absdiff_mean, ssim, class_confidence.

threshold.description: Threshold the metric crossed to trigger this event. Omit for sampled (non-triggered) events.

signal.description: Action hint. The sidecar always emits 'raw' — the bridge translates raw events into HID actions via a separate policy.
